source_evidence: These benefits can include tax deductions (e.g., pre-tax contributions), tax-deferred growth (no taxes until withdrawal), and/or tax-free withdrawals.
answer: Retirement savings accounts can offer tax benefits that encourage saving and investing for retirement. Depending on the account, contributions may qualify for tax deductions, investment growth may be tax-deferred until withdrawal, or withdrawals may be tax-free. Examples include workplace plans such as 401(k), 403(b), and 457(b) plans, as well as individual retirement accounts (IRAs). Depending on your circumstances, you may have more than one type of retirement account.
